question: Where’s the closest restaurant as you go toward Jay walk, New York, NY from Sloth Encounters, Hauppauge, NY?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sloth Encounters%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hauppauge%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Jay walk%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' LIMIT 1 ), path_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, path_line pl WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(pl.geom::geography, 1000) -- 1 km buffer around the direct line between start and end ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM start_point)::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
